searchText: MSRP $72,911. 2026 Brinkley Model I 235 is approximately 26' 11' in length with 1 slide. Features Maxx Air Fan 3,000W Inverter 50 Amp Service Ultimate Package Power Package Insulation Package King Bed More About This RV You'll love the amount of space you have in this travel trailer thanks to the large slide out in the main living area. There is comfy theater seating here, along with the kitchen appliances plus a pantry with drawers and an outlet. And a tri-fold sofa option can be chosen in place of theater seating if you're needing sleeping space for guests. You can dine at the pull-out dining table with a drawer, which is right in front of the pull-down interior/exterior screen. A full bath with a 36' x 30' shower will let you freshen up each day, and the king bed in the front bedroom includes a room divider in front for added privacy! The lightweight Model I travel trailer by Brinkley is the perfect choice for those looking for an easy tow and at-home comforts! There is a drop-frame chassis, high-performance Road Armor suspension equalizer system, and Demco EZ Latch trailer coupler that automatically latches when dropped onto a hitch ball without the need of a safety pin. Additional exterior features include square Euro frameless windows, automotive-grade paint, full-width LED strip lighting in the pass-thru, and a pet & property security campside tie-down to keep your gear and furry friends safe. Inside, you'll be wowed by Brinkley's CraftSense wood trim construction, residential solid surface kitchen countertops, dimmable bedroom lights, and marine-grade neon LED shower lighting to name a few stand-out features!
